entities.summary: Bambuco is a traditional music genre from Colombia. Its metric structure is similar to the European waltz or polska. Typically a bambuco piece is accompanied by a stylized group dance in either a 68 or 34 meter. bambuco is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
